_comment: EXAMPLE live test-site config — PLACEHOLDERS ONLY. Copy to testsite.config.json (GIT-IGNORED) and fill in your APPROVED non-production test-site values at runtime. Safe defaults are fail-closed (phase2Approved=false, contractRunApproved=false) so the example cannot execute anything as-is.
operatorNotes: Set phase2Approved=true and contractRunApproved=true, replace siteReferencePlaceholder with the approved non-production test-site reference, and point transportModulePlaceholder at a git-ignored bootstrap that builds an authenticated transport (real SDK + interactive auth).
